ⓘ How this lab calculates combat ＋

Cooldown starts on input. Each move has its own cooldown, measured from the start of its last use. Repeating it waits for both its cooldown and required animation time.

Links cancel recovery. An allowed follow-up starts when the previous active window ends, subject to its own cooldown. Without a link, it waits for full recovery.

A design model, not a hit confirm. One hit per move, with no hitstun, blockstun, range, or scaling. Links are proposed cancels; they do not guarantee a true combo. Frames are approximate at 60 fps.
